text:
Sam Nguyen: Hey team — brand new account, tried the quickstart, getting 403 on first POST to /v1/chat/completions. Error: 'billing_required'. trace=tr-abc123. Anyone seen this?
DevEx Bot: Received error 'billing_required' from API for trace tr-abc123. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart#billing-gates
Ana Patel: @Sam were you on trial? If trial expired the workspace gets auto-gated. Check Workspace > Settings > Billing > Payment method.
Sam Nguyen: I just signed up yesterday and used the free credits. CLI token is set. cURL I ran: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
``` response 403.
Mike L: Can you paste the full response body? 403 usually says 'billing_required' or 'account_suspended'.
Sam Nguyen: { "error": { "message": "billing_required: workspace needs active billing", "code": "billing_required", "trace": "tr-abc123" } }
Jess Carter: FYI we shipped a parity fix in the Node SDK — older SDKs suppressed helpful retry instructions so folks hit the raw 403. Recommend upgrading to fix UX.
Ana Patel: yep please try `npm i @redwood-inference/sdk@0.12.1` or pip/cli equivalents. Curl will still error but the SDK surfaces a friendly flow when workspace is in trial. Also Billing Bot can show workspace status.
Billing Bot: Workspace 'sam-workspace' status: TRIAL_EXPIRED -> Payment method required. Add card: https://billing.redwood.ai/workspaces/sam-workspace
Sam Nguyen: Ah — trial expired. I expected free credits to last 14 days. Where do I top up? I don't see billing page in UI.
Mike L: Are you a workspace owner? Only owners can add a card. Check People > Roles. If not, ask the owner to add payment.
Sam Nguyen: I'm the owner. I guess the invite flow bug hid the 'Add payment' button on mobile. On desktop now I see 'Add card'. Adding now.
DevEx Bot: tip: to iterate locally without hitting the gate, you can use the local emulator (dev mode only): https://github.com/redwood-inference/local-runner — not for prod.
Sam Nguyen: Card added and call succeeded. First successful call! Thanks all :tada: :raised_hands:
Jess Carter: Follow-up: we'll add a clearer first-run UX — detect trial expiry and surface 'Add payment' link during signup and quickstart error pages. Filing ticket.
Ana Patel: Ticket: DEX-914 - quickstart: surface billing link on first-run 403. Assigning to @Jess.
Sam Nguyen: Thanks team — maybe add a one-liner in quickstart FAQ about the 'billing_required' error so folks don't panic. :thumbsup:
Mike L: +1 on FAQ. Also I'll open a short PR to the quickstart README with troubleshooting steps.
Jess Carter: Noted. I'll update release notes for the SDK patch so customers know to upgrade.
DevEx Bot: If anyone else runs into this, please drop the trace id (like tr-abc123) and we'll pull logs.
